user.title: FLARE
user.description:
Installs both halves. Schedules provides the day-phase and colour curve sensors; Tracking registers the apply_lighting, compute_lighting_groups, compute_curve, compute_scene_coverage and ownership services and keeps track of which lights are currently being driven.

Pick the rooms to track - each becomes a state device with its own controlled/overridden counts and a Clear button. Lights in an area you don't pick simply aren't tracked, which means they're never left alone when something else takes them. You can add, retarget or remove these at any time, and add schedule sensors from the Schedules entry once it exists.

user.title: Add a FLARE schedule sensor
user.description: Adds a day-phase/curve sensor and phase-override select, grouped under a device with this name. Entities are prefixed with it too (e.g. "Living Room" -> sensor.living_room_flare). The schedule times and brightness/colour curve aren't set here - they're separate entities on the device once it's created, each starting at a sensible default and adjustable any time.

user.title: Add state device
user.description: A state device is a named tracking scope for override protection. Which lights it tracks is decided by whichever automation or service call passes its ID as tracking_device_id — not by anything set here. Optionally point it at an area, device, or lights just to place it under that area in Settings → Devices for tidiness.

init.title: FLARE options
init.description:
Bulb models that need two-step transitions, one pattern per line. This is the complete list the check uses — the box starts pre-filled with the models shipped with the integration, and you can add to it or remove from it freely.

Patterns are matched case-insensitively against “manufacturer model”, and * is a wildcard, e.g. *TRADFRI bulb* or IKEA*. Clearing the box entirely falls back to the shipped defaults; to stop being told about unlabelled bulbs, ignore the repair instead.

Once you save your own list it stays as you left it — a later release adding a newly discovered bulb won't change it.
